title: VPN Access Fails After Password Rotation
problem: User updated corporate password but VPN client keeps rejecting credentials and cannot connect remotely.
solution: Clear cached credentials in the VPN client, sign out of SSO session, and re-authenticate with the new password.

title: Node Build Fails on CI with Out-of-Memory
problem: A frontend build intermittently fails in CI due to JavaScript heap out-of-memory errors.
solution: Increase Node memory with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 and split the build into smaller chunks.

title: Micronaut Tests not being recognized by IntelliJ
problem: After opening a test class in Intellij, the @MicronautTest annotation is not properly highlighted, and the test class does not give you the option to run the tests, or you are able to run the tests, but they do not actually run, and they just report that no tests are found in that test class.
solution:
1.) Open maven on the right sidebar in IntelliJ
2.) Click Sync all maven projects
3.) Click Reload all maven projects
4.) Wait until both builds have completed and run the test class again. 

You may also need to perform a "mvn clean install" at the command line from the terminal inside IntelliJ.
